observations: Larger table has a gold-tone metal frame with vertical slats and a white marble-effect top.
Smaller table has a white fluted cylindrical base, a single drawer with a gold-tone handle, and a gold-tone circular base.
The tops of both tables show grey veining consistent with marble or marble-effect laminate.
Photo appears to be a professional product shot in a studio setting.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UPTODATE ENTERPRISE' is visible across the center.

risks.risk: Top material may be laminate/MDF rather than genuine marble.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the edge or the underside of the tabletop.

risks.risk: The drawer may be stuck, misaligned, or have a damaged track.
risks.proof: A video showing the drawer opening and closing smoothly.

risks.risk: The gold finish may have scratches, pitting, or oxidation not visible in studio lighting.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the metal frame and base in natural light.

proof_requests: Video of the drawer being opened and closed.
Close-up photo of the tabletop edge to confirm material.
Photos of the items in a domestic setting to verify they are in the seller's possession and check for scale.
response.reason: The item is a standard furniture type clearly depicted. It can be priced as a generic nesting table set at its worst-case material and functional state (laminate tops and non-functional drawer).
